noMatches.en: No matching suburbs. Clear the search to browse all regions, or contact MEL ONE with your location.
noMatches.zh: 未找到匹配地区。清除搜索可浏览全部区域，或联系 MEL ONE 告知您的位置。

messageRequired.zh: 请描述需要维修或维护的问题。

suburbRequired.zh: 请填写所在地区或邮编。

phoneRequired.en: Add a phone number for your preferred reply.
phoneRequired.zh: 您选择了电话回复，请填写有效电话号码。

emailRequired.en: Add an email address, such as name@example.com.
emailRequired.zh: 请填写有效邮箱，例如 name@example.com。

checkFields.en: Check the highlighted details before sending.
checkFields.zh: 发送前请检查并补全标出的信息。

failed.en: We could not send your enquiry. Your details remain in the form.
failed.zh: 咨询未能发送，您填写的内容已保留在表单中。

success.en: Thank you — your enquiry has been sent to MEL ONE. We will contact you to discuss the assessment. An appointment still needs our confirmation.
success.zh: 感谢您的咨询，信息已发送至 MEL ONE。我们会联系您讨论评估安排，上门预约仍须由我们确认。

fallback.zh: 请致电 0416 614 281，或发送邮件至 admin@melonemaintenance.com.au。

localPreview.en: Local preview: enquiries are not sent. Your details remain in the form.
localPreview.zh: 本地预览不会发送咨询。您填写的内容会保留在表单中。

tooMany.en: Too many requests. Please try again later.
tooMany.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。

notFoundHelp.en: The link may have changed. Browse the Chinese homepage or contact MEL ONE.
notFoundHelp.zh: 链接可能已变更。您可以返回中文首页，或联系 MEL ONE。
